interpretation.difference: candidate minus reference; negative error/delay difference is improvement
interpretation.statistical_unit: three independent training seeds; within-seed sequences are not extra training replicates
interpretation.uncertainty: mean and observed seed range/direction only; no significance or population generalization claims
interpretation.units: packed CFA grid cells; multiply errors by two for physical sensor pixels
interpretation.early_windows: static/oracle frames8..13; event conditions first six frames from test event13
interpretation.stable_window: last four frames, separate from the transient window
interpretation.recovery: three consecutive visible frames <=0.75 cell; unconfirmed late onset is censored; capped penalty is T-event, not RMST
interpretation.oracle: translation positive control reported separately and excluded from main effects
interpretation.capacity: A/B legacy; C/D historical content; E/F equal-capacity current-content branch retaining historical gates
